name: fabbrica-appstoreconnect
description: App Store Connect MCP server: texts, keywords, screenshots, IAP, review and release from Claude. Dangerous actions are off by default.
long_description: Local MCP server for the App Store Connect API. Uploads whole screenshot folders with a dry run first. Talks only to Apple hosts and reads files only from the folder you choose. Submit, release, delete, pricing and raw API calls are off by default; when enabled, every call needs a two-step confirmation in a system dialog that the AI cannot answer. Every write is logged to ~/.fabbrica-appstoreconnect/audit.log.

key_id.title: Key ID
key_id.description: 10-character Key ID from App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: UUID shown above the key list on the same page.

p8_path.title: Private key (.p8)
p8_path.description: AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 downloaded when the key was created. Use a key with the App Manager role.

files_root.title: Files folder
files_root.description: Required. The server uploads screenshots and videos only from inside this folder.

enable_metadata.title: Edit metadata
enable_metadata.description: Versions, texts, keywords, categories, review info, attach build.

enable_media.title: Upload media
enable_media.description: Screenshots, previews, header and search images.

enable_release.title: DANGEROUS: submit and release
enable_release.description: Submit for review, cancel, release, phased release. Each call needs a two-step confirmation in a system dialog.

enable_delete.title: DANGEROUS: delete
enable_delete.description: Delete screenshots, previews, localizations, unsubmitted versions, library images. Each call needs a two-step confirmation.

enable_pricing.title: DANGEROUS: pricing
enable_pricing.description: Change the app price. Each call needs a two-step confirmation.

enable_raw.title: DANGEROUS: raw API
enable_raw.description: Any App Store Connect API call. Writes need a two-step confirmation. Deleting apps, users and signing assets stay blocked.
